_description: Phase 9b: particle cannons, breakers, slugs, Singularity Drive, Gravity Lens, GSP, Synthesis. Generated by: tools/particle.py (source belgeler/wiki/parcacik/parcacik.json and the client's item data).

cannon_common._adaptation: a ship-specific UL cannon's base damage on its own ship x1.25 (FAQ: "substantial boost"); chain jump radius 400; abrasion weakness applies to all of the player's damage

drive_common._adaptation: area from the client items_package_event-deal-voyagers-igni-l_description "AOE damage within a 600-radius zone for 8s", Apex/Prime "900-radius zone when 6 units are equipped" (set: [count, multiplier, area]); fire range (range) adaptation; the area hits once per second for 8 s (each hit is the total damage of the drives); 0.5% per level to drive damage

drive._note: one random sub-attribute every 5 upgrade levels, at most 4; renewed with Horizon Shard, locked by Containment Node

attributes._adaptation: ranges are linear in quality order (C/MR-x01 lowest, UL/MR-x06 highest); percent (penetration is an integer)

renewal._source: https://darkorbitwiki.com/guides/assembly-cannons-and-refractors-restabilize/ (2026-02-27): cannon 7 qualities, breaker MR-01..06 (same first 6 values); refund: per the cannon FAQ (recycling returns 80% of the upgrade material). By quality order: replacement limit, replacement cost (OptiGrad Chip), recycling chip (including UL); for the breaker the first 6 values

lock._adaptation: Horizon Shard cost depends on the number of locked attributes, Containment Node cost is per locked attribute

synthesis._adaptation: group and table names from the client's translations (Synthesis_table_1 Nidhogg, _2 Helios, _3 Indra, Synthesis_drive_1/2); UL ship cannon 4 LEG (wiki; FAQ says 5 for two ships); drive/lens recipes 5 units + 1,000 U (darkorbitwiki intensify-synthesis, recording)
